committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Applies to all executive agencies, independent regulatory agencies, and federal project contractors managing major delayed or over-budget projects.
dimensions.evidence: the term 'covered agency' means--(A) an Executive agency... and (B) an independent regulatory agency

dimensions.assessment: Establishes administrative reporting, guidance, and website publication requirements for troubled projects.
dimensions.evidence: Director shall issue guidance requiring covered agencies to, on an annual basis, submit to the Director information relating to each covered project

dimensions.assessment: Focuses on tracking major federal acquisitions, procurements, and construction projects with cost overruns of at least $1 billion or multi-year delays.
dimensions.evidence: for which the amount spent on the project is not less than $1,000,000,000 more than the original cost estimate for the project

dimensions.assessment: Imposes government-wide agency reporting mandates and OMB oversight duties regarding major project transparency.
dimensions.evidence: requires the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) to collect information from federal agencies and report to Congress regarding projects

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent annual reporting requirement for federal agencies and the OMB.
dimensions.evidence: Director shall submit to Congress and post on the website of the Office of Management and Budget an annual report

missing_information: Exact administrative cost to agencies for compiling and submitting the required annual project data.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires federal agencies to report annually to the OMB on projects that are more than five years behind schedule or exceed original cost estimates by at least $1 billion.

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate. Read twice. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 467.
